climate: Cabernet Sauvignon, Syrah and Merlot sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

blurb.text: A Columbia Valley AVA straddling southeast Washington and northeast Oregon. After Yakima Valley it has the most vineyards and wineries in Washington, about 140 wineries and tasting rooms. Cabernet Sauvignon is over half of plantings, then Syrah and Merlot.
